format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    nav-buttons:
      - icon: github

---

```{ojs}
//| output: false
Plot = require("@observablehq/plot")
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
log = FileAttachment("nutrition.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
mealList = ["breakfast", "lunch", "dinner", "snack"]
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
dateExtent = d3.extent(log, d => d.date)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
macroColor = {
  return {
    domain: ["Protein", "Carbs", "Fat"],
    range: ["#2a9d8f", "#e9c46a", "#e76f51"],
    legend: true
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
filtered = log.filter(d =>
  meals.includes(d.meal) && d.date >= fromDate && d.date <= toDate
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
daily = Array.from(
  d3.rollup(filtered, v => ({
    calories: d3.sum(v, d => d.calories),
    protein: d3.sum(v, d => d.protein_g),
    carbs: d3.sum(v, d => d.carbs_g),
    fat: d3.sum(v, d => d.fat_g)
  }), d => +d.date),
  ([t, v]) => ({date: new Date(t), ...v})
).sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
macroRows = daily.flatMap(d => [
  {date: d.date, macro: "Protein", kcal: d.protein * 4},
  {date: d.date, macro: "Carbs", kcal: d.carbs * 4},
  {date: d.date, macro: "Fat", kcal: d.fat * 9}
])
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
mealAvg = meals.map(m => ({
  meal: m,
  kcal: daily.length ? d3.sum(filtered.filter(d => d.meal === m), d => d.calories) / daily.length : 0
}))
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
topFoods = Array.from(
  d3.rollup(filtered, v => d3.sum(v, d => d.calories), d => d.food),
  ([food, kcal]) => ({food, kcal})
).sort((a, b) => b.kcal - a.kcal).slice(0, 8)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
onTarget = daily.filter(d => Math.abs(d.calories - target) <= target * 0.1).length
```

```{=html}
<style>
  .value-box-area .observablehq { font-size: 2.8rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; }
</style>
```

## {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
viewof fromDate = Inputs.date({label: "From", value: dateExtent[0], min: dateExtent[0], max: dateExtent[1]})
```

```{ojs}
viewof toDate = Inputs.date({label: "To", value: dateExtent[1], min: dateExtent[0], max: dateExtent[1]})
```

```{ojs}
viewof meals = Inputs.checkbox(mealList, {label: "Meals", value: mealList, format: m => m[0].toUpperCase() + m.slice(1)})
```

```{ojs}
viewof target = Inputs.number([1200, 4000], {label: "Calorie target", value: 2000, step: 50})
```

Days within 10% of the target count as on target. Turning meals off shows partial daily totals.

## Column {width=25%}

::: {.valuebox icon="fire" color="primary"}
Avg daily calories

`{ojs} daily.length ? Math.round(d3.mean(daily, d => d.calories)).toLocaleString() : "–"`
:::

::: {.valuebox icon="egg-fried" color="success"}
Avg daily protein (g)

`{ojs} daily.length ? Math.round(d3.mean(daily, d => d.protein)) : "–"`
:::

::: {.valuebox icon="bullseye" color="info"}
Days on target

`{ojs} daily.length ? Math.round(100 * onTarget / daily.length) + "%" : "–"`
:::

## Column {width=75%}

### Row {height=60%}

::: {.card title="Daily calories by macro"}
```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 760,
  height: 340,
  x: {type: "utc", label: null, domain: [dateExtent[0], d3.utcDay.offset(dateExtent[1], 1)]},
  y: {label: "Calories", grid: true},
  color: macroColor,
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(macroRows, {x: "date", interval: "day", y: "kcal", fill: "macro", tip: {format: {x: d3.utcFormat("%b %-d")}}}),
    Plot.ruleY([target], {stroke: "#333", strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
    Plot.text([target], {x: dateExtent[0], y: d => d, text: d => `target ${d}`, dy: -6, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```
:::

### Row {height=40%}

::: {.card title="Avg calories per day by meal"}
```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 400,
  height: 200,
  marginLeft: 70,
  marginRight: 30,
  x: {label: "Calories"},
  y: {label: null, domain: mealList},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(mealAvg, {x: "kcal", y: "meal", fill: "#4e79a7"}),
    Plot.text(mealAvg, {x: "kcal", y: "meal", text: d => Math.round(d.kcal), dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11}),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```
:::

::: {.card title="Top foods by total calories"}
```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 400,
  height: 200,
  marginLeft: 150,
  x: {label: "Calories"},
  y: {label: null, domain: topFoods.map(d => d.food)},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(topFoods, {x: "kcal", y: "food", fill: "#4e79a7"}),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```
:::
